breakdown.description: The prompt makes the torsional shear vanish at the outer surface, even though the torsional shear stress is also maximal there for a solid circular shaft.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly removes the erroneous instruction that torsional shear stress vanishes at the outer surface. Instead, Part (b) explicitly computes the torsional shear stress at the outer surface using τ = T·c/J, and Part (c) uses τxy = τ from part (b) in the plane stress analysis. This matches the ground truth, which also includes both bending normal stress and torsional shear stress in the combined stress state analysis.
